source.title: 16. Diabetes Care in the Hospital: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026
source.citation: American Diabetes Association Professional Practice Committee for Diabetes. 16. Diabetes care in the hospital: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026. Diabetes Care 2026;49(Suppl. 1):S339–S355.

guideline_boundary: Formal recommendations are ADA panel statements represented as author_conclusion atoms tagged guideline_recommendation. Results from cited studies remain secondary reports anchored to this Standards chapter; calculated differences are explicitly marked calculated_from_reported_data.
schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom schema has no guideline_recommendation atom kind, so formal recommendations use author_conclusion with descriptive tags.
ADA recommendation evidence grades are preserved in tags because the schema has no dedicated grade field.
The chapter is a guideline/Standards section; secondary study summaries cannot substitute for extraction from cited primary publications.
extraction_limitations: The full ADA guideline-development methodology, evidence-grading definitions, and contributor disclosures are outside this exact source and are referenced by the chapter.
Bibliography entries are not atomized; all 198 are preserved in the reference task queue.
All atoms remain needs_review because this processing run is not independent human verification.
No external current-practice or regulatory verification was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
protocol_version_note: The governing project file is named summary-evaluation-appraisal-protocol-v4-compact.md; its internal heading identifies Integrated Compact v3. The v4-named current project source was followed and the naming mismatch is recorded.
